author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-PCWeight: Batch R^2-based PC Weighting for Residualized Graph
abstract: Label-free per-PC weighting for the graph path: compute batch R^2 on pre-residualization PCs, set w_j = sqrt(1 - R2_j), apply to residualized PCs, then build equal-quota balanced cosine kNN (k=48). Embedding remains sc.pp.combat + PCA64. Goal: preserve ARI/NMI while keeping mixing strong.
